layers.authority: Public security and border control bodies, Yunnan Province
layers.process: Everyone entering or leaving Yunnan's border areas (the counties that touch Myanmar, Laos or Vietnam) must carry valid identity papers and accept border checks at checkpoints on the roads in. Without valid papers, or refusing a check, a person may not enter or leave the border area. Temporary checkpoints can be set up for security, counter-terrorism or anti-drug work.

zone-requirements.note: The regulation does not name a separate pass for foreigners; whether a border management zone pass is needed for a given place is set nationally and locally and was not checked.

laws.rule: In Yunnan, cross the national border only at a designated port or border crossing, with valid papers, and accept the border check. Crossing elsewhere with valid papers: a warning and a possible fine of CNY 50 (about A$11). Avoiding a border check or using forged or borrowed papers: papers taken, a warning and a possible fine of CNY 100 to 300 (about A$21 to A$64). AUD at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026 (A$1 = CNY 4.6877).

Entering or leaving a Yunnan border area without valid papers or refusing a check, and not stopping when told: a warning and a possible fine of CNY 100 to 300 (about A$21 to A$64). Refusing to cooperate with a border check or seriously disrupting a checkpoint: a warning and a possible fine of CNY 500 to 1,500 (about A$107 to A$320). AUD at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026 (A$1 = CNY 4.6877).

Lijiang: visitors must follow the law, public manners and each attraction's rules, respect local customs, culture and religion, and look after tourism resources, the environment and facilities. A visitor who goes into an area that is not developed or not open, and has to be rescued, pays the rescue cost together with the trip organiser (article 29).
laws.penalty_signal: Rescue cost is borne by the trip organiser and the person rescued. No fine on the visitor in the article read.
laws.heading: 丽江市旅游条例 (Lijiang Tourism Regulation)

laws.rule: People in a scenic area, including visitors, must follow the management body's rules, look after the scenery and facilities, protect the environment, and not damage the resources or change their shape. Vehicles must keep to set routes and parking points (article 30).
laws.penalty_signal: Fine CNY 50 to 200 (about A$10.67 to A$42.66) if the person does not correct the breach; CNY 200 to 1,000 (about A$42.66 to A$213) in serious cases (article 46). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
laws.heading: 云南省风景名胜区条例 (Yunnan Province Scenic Areas Regulation)

laws.rule: Lijiang Old Town: selling and setting off fireworks is banned in Dayan Old Town (article 16). Banned acts include spitting or urinating in public, littering, letting poultry, livestock and pets loose, handing out flyers, setting up stalls, and scribbling or hanging things on buildings and trees without approval (article 19). Plants and trees may not be damaged, loudspeakers and loud touting are banned, and outdoor noise is limited to 55 decibels by day and 45 at night (articles 21 to 23). Motor vehicles other than official ones may not enter Dayan Old Town without approval, and bikes and tricycles must be pushed (article 24).
laws.penalty_signal: Breaches of articles 16, 19, 23 and 24: warning and possibly CNY 100 to 500 (about A$21.33 to A$107) (article 30). Plants, loudspeakers and similar (articles 21, 22): warning and possibly CNY 30 to 50 (about A$6.40 to A$10.67) (article 31). Setting off fireworks: warning for an individual and possibly CNY 100 to 200 (about A$21.33 to A$42.66); selling them: CNY 500 to 1,000 (about A$107 to A$213) (article 31). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
